monitored_text: Do you provide design support? What are your lead times? What file formats do you accept? Can you handle validation and testing? Yes. Our team offers DFM feedback specific to moldability, gate location, and cycle-time optimization. Tooling and first-run lead times vary by mold complexity and cavitation; production run lead times depend on volume. We typically work with STEP, IGES, and STL files, and our engineering team can accommodate most common CAD formats. Yes. We provide mold validation studies, material certifications, and production part approval (PPAP) documentation where required.
